description: A copy of the r-cursor-1-nav fixture opened read/write. Snapshot A on T with ID and K held through its Fields; then dynaset B on T in the same Database with K held, used for the change and closed. A: no value read (the control of one-field-read). B: K = 111 on ID 1. A: read K, then ID, of row 1. Then on A: MoveFirst and a walk of ID and K by MoveNext to EOF. Asks which of A's populated but unread values a later publication changes.
